# Security policy

Kadoozle is a small wishlist app for families and friends, live at
https://www.kadoozle.app. Only the latest version on `main` is supported; it is
what runs in production.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report security problems privately, not in a public issue:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/elvic-jan/wishlist/security) of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability** and describe the problem, how to reproduce it,
   and what someone could do with it.

You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix is live, the report can be made
public with credit to you, if you'd like.

## Please don't

- Access, change or delete other people's accounts, wishlists or reservations.
- Run automated scanners or load tests against the live site.
- Send emails or invites to people who didn't ask for them.

Testing against your own local copy of the app (see the README) is welcome.
